records.entryNote: Headword OCR "porto, jwi, 5tum" = porto, avi, atum.

note: L&S porto, -avi, -atum 释义 "to bear or carry along, to convey any thing heavy"，与 portare「运」一致；同条给出与 fero「带」同源。
